name: Heart of Cleopatra

features.name: Cluster tumbles
features.description: Five or more connected symbols win on a 7x7 grid.

features.name: Money Spots
features.description: Wilds leave multiplier spots that double with each win and pay an instant reward.

features.name: Persistent bonus spots
features.description: 10–30 free spins in which Money Spots hold and grow until the round ends.

review:
A 7x7 Egyptian cluster game with Money Spots. When the Cleopatra wild is part of a win, it leaves a Money Spot behind – starting at 1x or 2x and doubling with every further win there. When the tumbles end, each spot gets a cash value of 0.1x to 10x, multiplied by its final value.

Three to seven bonus symbols give 10 to 30 free spins, where Money Spots stay put all round and pay out at the end. Up to 10,000x, 96.48% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
